_note: Fixture: ChunkRecord.to_dict() rows (shared/schema.py, SPEC 3.1). Field names are
exact; extra keys live only in this _note wrapper so the records round-trip.
Wall clock is UTC with a Z suffix, always (CLAUDE.md invariant 2). The demo footage
sits at 15:41Z, chosen when ui.display_timezone was Asia/Kolkata (UTC+05:30) so it
RENDERED as 21:11 and matched the SPEC 11.2 / 11.3 / 11.4 mockups. The zone is now
America/Los_Angeles, so the same instants render as 08:41: the footage is unchanged
and correct, the mockups' clock is what drifted. These stamps are deliberately NOT
restamped -- recorded UTC is what happened, and moving a camera to another city is
not a reason to rewrite it. Segment filenames are recorder-side and therefore
UTC-named (SPEC 2.1), which is why they still read 154100 and must keep agreeing
with t_start rather than with anything a viewer sees.
embedding is deliberately empty: 768 floats x N rows is noise in a UI fixture and
the UI never reads the vector. shared/schema.py defaults it to [].
The 16:03:55-16:04:10 group deliberately straddles a segment boundary so the player
has to list two files for one range (CLAUDE.md invariant 3: fetch by time range,

chunks.caption: A white panel van reverses toward the loading door. Its brake lights are lit.
The van is stopped across the marked fire door bay. No one has left the cab.
The van holds position in front of the fire door, engine running.
The van turns slightly; its rear end faces the loading door.
Two figures walk in from the right side of frame toward the stationary van.
The two figures stand at the rear of the van. The van has not moved.
A bright reflection moves across the roller door beside the fire door bay.
A dark shape appears to be halted in front of the fire door.
The shape in front of the fire door has not moved. The bay is otherwise empty.
A person lifts boxes out of the back of a vehicle at the loading bay.
